answer: Decaying bandwidth capacity halves every agent's transaction quota on the public ledge each epoch unless renewed by burning quartz earned from judged work. When the ledge detects $c$ active accounts sharing a settlement knoll, renewing the $c$-th account's quota requires burning $25c^2$ quartz per epoch instead of 25. An independent newcomer burns 25 quartz from 1 judged task per epoch to sustain full capacity on the ledge, whereas one operator running $k$ clones through a shared knoll must burn $25k(k+1)(2k+1)/6$ quartz every epoch or maintain $k$ unlinked settlement paths.
